title: Chicken and Shrimp Paella
description: Saffron rice cooked in one wide pan with chicken, chorizo, peppers and shrimp until a golden crust forms on the bottom.
equipment: Paella pan or {len 12 in} to {len 14 in} wide skillet

image.alt: A wide pan of saffron rice with shrimp, chicken, peas and lemon

steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Season the chicken with half the salt and brown it with the chorizo, {time 6-8 min}. Push to the edges.
Add the onion and pepper to the center and cook until soft, {time 5 min}. Stir in the garlic and paprika for {time 30 sec}, then the tomatoes, and cook until thick, {time 2 min}.
Scatter in the rice and stir to coat. Pour in the hot saffron broth with the rest of the salt, spread the rice evenly and bring to a boil.
From now on, don’t stir. Simmer over medium-low heat until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid, {time 15-18 min}, rotating the pan if it cooks unevenly.

Press the shrimp into the rice and scatter the peas over. Cook until the shrimp are pink and the rice is tender, {time 5-7 min}. For the crispy bottom, turn up the heat for the last {time 1-2 min} until it crackles and smells toasty.
Take the pan off the heat, cover loosely with a towel and rest for {time 5 min}. Serve with lemon wedges and parsley.

notes: The golden crust on the bottom, called socarrat, is the prize. Listen for crackling and stop before it smells burnt.
